$comment: Feature registry: every feature that exists or is planned, and the links between them. Plans name these ids in frontmatter (features: [adds:<id>]). statuses: what each feature status means and the tag the map shows. areas: map columns 0-3, or "band" for a full-width row; code is a 3-letter label. features: id (kebab-case, permanent), area, name, status, description, pages / api / code (where it lives), introduced_by (the plan that adds a planned feature, or <prefix>:<id> for an external plan, or introduced_by_tracker). links: from -> to with kind needs (from cannot work without to), gate (to checks or blocks from), trigger (from starts to), data (from sends data to to) or exposes (from is an API/SDK/CLI surface of to); partial: true when only part depends; note says why. Gaps live in gaps.json, not here.
